snippet.title: Remember Warcraft III Tower Defense Maps? I Missed Them, So I Made This. Jarred Defense
snippet.description:
Jarred Defense on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4525520/Jarred_Defense/?utm_source=youtube&utm_content=trailerrelease

A difficult maze-building tower defense about Yuki, a cat trapped in a teleporting jar. Protect it from robots and endure its unhelpful comments. Build your own paths, adapt as levels change, unlock powerful items, and uncover Yuki’s story. A love letter to Warcraft III custom maps.
